title: Tasty Chicken Bread Recipe
content:
Delicious and soft chicken bread which tastes so yummy and is perfect for this iftar season. Make this for your kids then will love it for sure.

This was on my bucket list for quite some time, finally, I made it a few weeks back. I had a bunch of herbs, so used those to make this dough and it was perfect. You can make this in different shapes. 

I made this herbed dough and the filling was little creamy and spicy which tasted great. I will soon share an Indian version of a filling.

 

Chicken Bread Recipe

Prep time: 15 mins

Cook time: 20 mins

Total time: 35 mins

 

Recipe type: Brunch

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

FOR DOUGH:

All-Purpose Flour / Maida - 2 cups

Dry Yeast - 1.5 teaspoon

Sugar - 1 tablespoon

Salt to taste

Dried Parsley - 1 tablespoon

Dried Oregano - 2 teaspoons

Red Chilli Flakes - 2 teaspoons

Olive Oil - 2 tablespoons

Warm Water as needed

Milk - 2 tablespoons for brushing on top

 

FOR FILLING:

Oil - 1 tablespoon

Onion - 1 large chopped finely

Green Chillies - 2 chopped finely

Curry leaves a sprig

Ginger Garlic Paste - 1 tablespoon

Chicken Breast - 2 cooked and cut into small pieces

Turmeric Powder - 1 teaspoon

Salt to taste

Chilli Powder - 1 teaspoon

Garam Masala Powder - 1 teaspoon

All-Purpose Flour / Maida - 1 tablespoon

Chicken Stock - ½ cup

 

Instructions

Take yeast, sugar in a bowl and add in warm water. Let it sit for 5 mins.

Take flour, salt, all the herbs and olive oil. Mix well.

Add yeast water and extra water and knead to a soft dough.

Add more oil on top and set aside to rise for 1 to 2 hours.

While the dough is rising. Make the filling. Heat oil in a pan,

Add in onion, curry leaves, ginger-garlic paste and green chillies. Saute for 2 mins.

Add salt and spice powders and mix well.

Add in all-purpose flour and saute for a min.

Add in Chicken stock and cooked chicken and mix well. Set aside to cool.

Once the dough has risen. Punch out the air and divide it into 2 portions.

Take a portion and roll into a large rectangle. Spoon filling inside and seal from the sides.

Now place it in a parchment-lined baking pan.

Let it rise for 30 mins to 1 hour.

In the last 10 mins of rising, preheat oven to 200 degrees C.

Now brush the top with egg or milk. Bake for 20 mins.

Remove and cool a little.

Serve it.
content_hi:
स्वादिष्ट और नरम चिकन ब्रेड जो स्वादिष्ट है और इस इफ्तार के मौसम के लिए एकदम सही है। अपने बच्चों के लिए इसे बनाएं और फिर इसे ज़रूर पसंद करेंगे।

यह कुछ समय के लिए मेरी बाल्टी सूची में था, आखिरकार, मैंने इसे कुछ सप्ताह पहले बनाया। मेरे पास जड़ी बूटियों का एक गुच्छा था, इसलिए इस आटे को बनाने के लिए उन का उपयोग किया और यह एकदम सही था। आप इसे विभिन्न आकृतियों में बना सकते हैं।

मैंने इस जड़ी बूटी का आटा बनाया और भरने में थोड़ा मलाईदार और मसालेदार था जो बहुत अच्छा था। मैं जल्द ही एक भरने का भारतीय संस्करण साझा करूंगा।

 

चिकन ब्रेड रेसिपी

तैयारी का समय: 15 मिनट

पकाने का समय: 20 मिनट

कुल समय: 35 मिनट

 

पकाने की विधि प्रकार: ब्रंच

भोजन: भारतीय

सर्व करता है: 4 सर्विंग्स

 

सामग्री

DOUGH के लिए:

ऑल-पर्पस आटा / मैदा - 2 कप

सूखी खमीर - 1.5 चम्मच

चीनी - 1 बड़ा चम्मच

नमक स्वादअनुसार

सूखे अजमोद - 1 बड़ा चम्मच

सूखे अजवायन की पत्ती - 2 चम्मच

लाल मिर्च के गुच्छे - 2 चम्मच

जैतून का तेल - 2 बड़े चम्मच

आवश्यकतानुसार गर्म पानी

दूध - शीर्ष पर ब्रश करने के लिए 2 बड़े चम्मच

 

भरने के लिए:

तेल - 1 बड़ा चम्मच

प्याज - 1 बड़ा कटा हुआ बारीक

हरी मिर्च - 2 बारीक कटी हुई

करी एक टहनी छोड़ती है

अदरक लहसुन का पेस्ट - 1 बड़ा चम्मच

चिकन स्तन - 2 पकाया और छोटे टुकड़ों में काट लें

हल्दी पाउडर - 1 चम्मच

नमक स्वादअनुसार

मिर्च पाउडर - 1 चम्मच

गरम मसाला पाउडर - 1 चम्मच

ऑल-पर्पस आटा / मैदा - 1 बड़ा चम्मच

चिकन स्टॉक - ½ कप

 

अनुदेश

एक कटोरे में खमीर, चीनी लें और गर्म पानी में मिलाएं। इसे 5 मिनट तक बैठने दें।

आटा, नमक, सभी जड़ी बूटियों और जैतून का तेल लें। अच्छी तरह मिलाएं।

खमीर पानी और अतिरिक्त पानी जोड़ें और नरम आटा गूंध करें।

शीर्ष पर अधिक तेल जोड़ें और 1 से 2 घंटे के लिए उठने के लिए अलग सेट करें।

जबकि आटा उठ रहा है। भरने बनाओ। एक पैन में तेल गर्म करें,

प्याज, करी पत्ता, अदरक-लहसुन का पेस्ट और हरी मिर्च डालें। 2 मिनट के लिए Saute।

नमक और मसाला पाउडर डालकर अच्छी तरह मिलाएँ।

सभी प्रयोजन के आटे में जोड़ें और एक मिनट के लिए saute।

चिकन स्टॉक और पका हुआ चिकन में जोड़ें और अच्छी तरह मिलाएं। ठंडा करने के लिए अलग सेट करें।

एक बार आटा बढ़ गया है। हवा को बाहर पंच करें और इसे 2 भागों में विभाजित करें।

एक भाग लें और एक बड़े आयत में रोल करें। चम्मच भरने के अंदर और पक्षों से सील।

अब इसे पार्चमेंट-लाइनेड बेकिंग पैन में रखें।

इसे 30 मिनट से 1 घंटे के लिए उठने दें।

उठने के अंतिम 10 मिनट में, ओवन को 200 डिग्री C पर प्रीहीट करें।

अब अंडे या दूध के साथ शीर्ष पर ब्रश करें। 20 मिनट के लिए सेंकना।

निकालें और थोड़ा ठंडा करें।

इसे दें या इसकी सेवा करें।

related.title: Tasty Oven Roasted Chicken ( With Vegetables ) Recipe
related.title_hi: टेस्टी ओवेन रोस्टेड चिकन (सब्जियों के साथ) रेसिपी
related.content:
Delicious and very easy roast chicken with veggies tastes so yummy. It takes less than 10 mins to put together. Healthy chicken with veggies.

This is an easy dinner or lunch to put together. It takes less than 10 mins to put together. Once you assembled everything it takes around 40 to 45 mins to cook. The chicken is so flavourful and tastes so juicy. The chicken outside has a nice crust in them and the inside is so juicy.

 

Roast Chicken with Vegetables

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 55 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 5 servings

 

Ingredients

Chicken - 1 whole chicken, cut into 12 pieces

Oil - 3 tablespoons

Carrot - 2 chopped

Cauliflower - 2 cups

Onion - 1 chopped

Potato - 1 peeled and cubed

Garlic - 10 cloves with skins on

 

FOR SPICE MIX:

Red Chilli Flakes - 1 tablespoon

Chilli Powder or Paprika - 1 tablespoon

Salt - 1 tablespoon

Parsley - 2 tablespoons

Oregano - 1 tablespoon

Sumac - 2 tablespoons

 

Instructions

Preheat oven to 200 degrees C. Mix spice mix together and set aside.

Take veggies in a baking pan. Add spice mix and oil and toss well.

Place chicken over it and sprinkle with spice mix and oil and mix well.

Pop it in the oven and bake for 35 to 45 mins.

Remove and serve it.

related.title: Tasty Varutharacha Chicken Curry Recipe
related.content:
Delicious spicy chicken curry made using roasted spice masala and coconut masala which is so yummy with rice.

This chicken curry is made using roasted whole spices masala which tastes super delicious. The freshly roasted spices give so much flavor to the chicken curry and make it super yummy.

 

Varutharacha Chicken Curry Recipe

Prep time: 15 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 1 hour

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 6 serving

 

Ingredients

Coconut Oil - ¼ cup

Fennel seeds / Sombu / Saunf - 2 teaspoons

Cumin Seeds / Jeerakam - 1 teaspoon

Bay Leaf - 1

Cardamom / Yelakai - 5

Cloves / Krambu - 5

Cinnamon / Pattai - 1 stick

Brinji Ilai / Pandan Leaf - 1

Chicken - 1 kg

Shallots - 30 peeled and chopped finely

Tomato - 4 to 5 chopped finely

Green Chillies - 2 slit

Ginger Garlic Paste - 2 tablespoons

Potato - 1 peeled and cubed

Salt to taste

Tomato - 1 chopped for adding last

Curry Leaves a handful for adding last

 

TO ROAST & GRIND:

Dry Red Chilli - 10 to 12

Coriander Leaves - 4 tablespoons

Cumin Seeds - 2 teaspoons

Black Pepper - 2 teaspoons

Curry leaves a handful

TO GRIND:

Coconut - 1 cup grated

Roasted Gram Dal / Pori Kadalai - 1 teaspoon

Fennel Seeds / Sombu / Saunf - 1 teaspoon

 

Instructions

Heat a pan, add whole spices to toast. Cook till golden. Take it in a blender and puree till smooth. Set aside.

Take coconut, gram dal, fennel and grind to a smooth paste.

Now heat oil in a pan, add in whole spices, onions and cook till golden.

Add in ginger garlic paste and saute till raw smell leaves.

Add in tomatoes and curry leaves and mix well.

Add in chicken and cook till 5 to 6 mins.

Add in roasted coconut masala and water. Mix well.

Add this in a pressure cooker and cook for 2 whistles.

Take it off the heat and open the cooker.

Add in potatoes and cook till it is done.

Add in coconut masala and simmer for 10 to 15 mins.

Take the curry off the heat and add in tomato and curry leaves.

Serve it.

related.title: Tasty Pepper Chicken ( Milagu )  Gravy Recipe
related.title_hi: टेस्टी काली मिर्च चिकन (मिलगु) ग्रेवी रेसिपी
related.content:
Spicy black pepper chicken gravy goes well with roti, rice or idli or dosa too. This spicy chicken curry tastes super delicious and very peppery.

I have shared a few varieties of pepper chicken and mutton recipes here. But I haven’t shared the pepper chicken gravy which we simply love. I make this all the time. So here it is. It is not at all hard to make, it is super easy to make and taste simply amazing.

 

Pepper Chicken Gravy Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 55 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Chicken - 500 grams

Coconut Oil - ¼ cup

Bay Leaf - 1

Onion - 2 large sliced thinly

Green Chilli - 2 slit

Ginger Garlic Paste - 2 tablespoons

Tomatoes - 2 large chopped finely

Turmeric Powder - 1 teaspoon

Chilli powder - 2 teaspoons

Garam Masala Powder - 2 teaspoons

Salt to taste

Coriander Leaves for garnishing

 

FOR ROASTING & GRINDING:

Oil - 1 tsp

Fennel Seeds / Saunf / Sombu - 1 tablespoon

Cinnamon / Pattai - 1 stick

Black Pepper - 1 tablespoon

Coriander Seeds - 2 tablespoons

Onion - 1 large chopped

 

Instructions

Pressure cook chicken with a little salt for 2 to 3 whistles. Set aside.

Heat little oil in a pot. Add in spices and toast them. Take it in a blender.

Add onions and cook till golden brown. Add it with the spices and grind till smooth. Set aside.

Heat oil in a pot, add in onions, chilies and bay leaf. Cook till golden.

Add in ginger garlic paste and cook till raw smell leaves.

Add in tomatoes and cook till mushy.

Add in the ground masala and mix well.

Add salt, turmeric powder, chili powder, and garam masala and cook till oil separates.

Now add in the chicken along with any cooking liquid.

Mix well and simmer till oil separates.

Add coriander leaves and mix well.

Serve it.

related.title: Tasty Cheesy Chicken Nuggets ( Kids Special ) Recipe
related.title_hi: टेस्टी चीज चिकन नगेट्स (किड्स स्पेशल) रेसिपी
related.content:
Cheesy chicken nuggets will be your kid's new favorite snack. So delicious and these are pan-fried instead of deep frying so it is more healthy.

This is so easy to make, you can make a bunch of these and freeze them. So you can fry them whenever you need them. Many of my readers have been asking for toddler nuggets recipe. I made this for my little one and she loved it to the core.

 

Cheesy Chicken Nuggets Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 15 mins

Total time: 25 mins

 

Recipe type: Snacks

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 2 servings

 

Ingredients

Boneless Chicken Breast - 2 cut into strips

Oil for pan-frying

 

FOR CRISPY COATING:

Breadcrumbs - 1 cup

Cheese - ¼ cup grated

Dried Parsley - 1 teaspoon

Garlic Powder - 2 teaspoons

Salt to taste

Pepper to taste

 

FOR BATTER:

Cornflour - 2 tablespoons

All-Purpose Flour - 4 tablespoons

Salt to taste

Pepper to taste

 

Instructions

Mix all ingredients for crispy coating and set aside.

Take all ingredients for batter and mix well.

Take the chicken and dip in the batter, coat in breadcrumbs.

Now pan fry till golden brown on each side.

Serve with ketchup.
